verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own docs say chat is one of the tools added to a project alongside to-dos, card tables and calendars, and that teams can 'just chat in Basecamp instead' of Slack, with multiple chat rooms possible per project. That is chat inside the same tool used to plan work. Missing for 10: detail on chat capabilities such as direct messages, mentions in chat or notifications, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat experience.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: Add the tools you need (to-dos, message boards, chat, a calendar, card tables), then invite co-workers, clients, even AI Agents.
With Basecamp you don’t need Slack, WhatsApp, or another chat app. Just chat in Basecamp instead.
Add multiple message boards, chat rooms, card tables, or other tools to a single project.
Card Tables are our take on kanban boards. Add cards, set up columns, and move work through phases.
